articles.title: A Deal to Stop the Bombs — But Will It Last?
articles.summary: President Trump signed a paper with Iran to pause a war that has killed thousands. But Israel is still fighting in Lebanon, and leaders are arguing. Can a 60-day window really bring peace?

articles.title: Working at Home, But Treated Unfairly — Millions of Women Speak Up
articles.summary: Thirty years ago, a big rule called Convention 177 said home-based workers should have the same rights as factory workers. But only 13 countries agreed to it, and in India, women like Shehnaz Bano still earn just $1 per jacket piece.

articles.title: Brothers on Opposite Teams at the World Cup — Who Does Mom Cheer For?
articles.summary: Desire and Guela Doue grew up together in France but now play for different countries. At the World Cup, they could face each other on June 30. Four sets of siblings are in the tournament, but these two might actually play against each other!
